caption: The drawing depicts a wooden clock with a rectangular shape, featuring a brownish-red wood grain texture. The clock has two prominent vertical columns on either side of its front facade, with decorative molding at the top and bottom, and a wide, outward-curving base. The upper section contains a clock face with black Roman numerals and two black hands on a white background, along with a small circular window below the center of the dial. Below the clock face is a square panel divided into two sections: the upper part contains a diamond-shaped decorative element featuring blue, white, and green geometric and floral patterns on a black background; the lower part is a glass panel through which a circular, gold-colored pendulum is visible inside the clock case. The overall composition is centered on a plain, light beige background, with no other objects or details present around the clock.
title: Clock
